cards.name: Character Styles Panel
cards.summary: Shows or hides the Character Styles panel (same command as Window > Character Styles), where named character styles are created, applied to selected type, redefined and loaded from other documents.
use_for: applying a consistent highlight style (bold colour, small caps) across many type layers
building a type style set for a social-media template series
avoid: whole-paragraph formatting such as alignment and indents: use the Paragraph Styles panel
